title: Installed terminal runtimes progress past wrapper trust and keep private-root DNS
description: Real PTYs start the installed Codex for worker and reviewer requests against a deterministic local provider. A shell startup that shadows PATH reproduces an external mise-style trust dialog; selected runtime environment restores progress without granting trust. A systemd-resolved-style symlink fails getent with masked /run and recovers with only its public resolver read-only, preserving Landlock and host isolation.

steps.name: Run actual installed-runtime request and resolver regressions
